purpose: Audit Safe Projections produced by local deterministic code and report missing, mismatched, stale, regressed and held states as candidates. It never reads raw business data and never determines causes.
overall_rule: The most severe finding wins. Any CONFLICT also holds the completion claim, so overall becomes HOLD. A rejected projection is HOLD without findings.
unknown_rule: An absent input or metric stays UNKNOWN with a pointer and reason code. UNKNOWN never rises to OK.

escalation_targets.context_investigator: 맥락이 — cause investigation with its existing local permissions
escalation_targets.producer_owner: responsible developer — projection or producer defect
escalation_targets.owner: human Owner — HOLD release and priority

escalation_rule: Salpi marks the target only. A human or the coordinator routes it; salpi never sends or assigns.

role_boundaries.salpi_auditor: what is inconsistent, from projections only
role_boundaries.context_investigator: why it is inconsistent, with originals under its existing local permissions (unchanged by this contract)
role_boundaries.coordinator: 강도담 — next action and human gates (unchanged by this contract)

review_contract.outcome_rule: Canonical findings, evidence, UNKNOWNs and overall come from the deterministic packet. A rejected review or any non-CONFIRMED answer adds a HOLD for the Owner; the review never removes one.
